start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:reach-local-businesses-by-zip-code." Find the local businesses of one kind in a zip code from the person's map data connection, score them on what their reviews say (complaints about slow quotes, a spike in new reviews in the last 90 days), write to the addresses the person keeps (by default their gmail or info@ address) from a separate sending identity with one local detail in the first line, send on Saturday, then call the same list, with replies, bounces and calls recorded and the two openings compared.

3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is compare.
